items.briefing:
Australians using Anthropic's AI tools (such as Claude) should be on alert after reports that users are being targeted by infostealer malware designed to steal login sessions and account credentials. This means attackers can hijack your AI account without needing your password. Separately, a new malware operation called Gryxa has been identified, notable because AI tools were reportedly used to help build it — a reminder that cybercriminals are using the same technology we rely on every day to develop more sophisticated threats.

**Practical tip:** If you use any AI platform for work, enable multi-factor authentication on your account and log out of sessions when you're finished.

featured.title: AI helped build Gryxa malware operation, report says
